def execute_command(image) -> List[ImagePatch]:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    car_patches = image_patch.find("white car")
    street_patches = image_patch.find("street")
    entrance_gate_patches = image_patch.find("entrance gate")

    if not car_patches or not street_patches or not entrance_gate_patches:
        return []

    car_patches_near_gate = [car for car in car_patches if distance(car, entrance_gate_patches[0]) < 100]

    return car_patches_near_gate
